Job Description 
 · Design, develop and test new embedded software. 
 · Working on BSPs for cutting edge Intel processor based boards. 
 · Design and development of system and device driver software for many standard operating systems. 
 · Working with hardware engineers during the definition, design and verification phases. 
 · Working on customer issues which get escalated to the engineering team. 
 · Developing board level and system test software and procedures. 
 · Working on customer issues which get escalated to the engineering team. 
 
 Qualification 
 · Minimum 2-5 years of relevant industry experience. Bachelors degree in computer Science, computer engineering or related discipline and experience with all of the following: 
 · Very proficient in Embedded C . 
 · In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience of writing Linux/Windows/VxWorks device drivers. 
 · Working knowledge of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP) and PCI express . 
 · Good appreciation of hardware. 
 
 Experience with any of the following would be desirable: 
 · In-depth knowledge of current Intel x86 architecture . 
 · PCI Express, including bridges and switches. 
 · 10GbE, network switch configuration and management. 
 · SRIO fabrics. 
 · Multi-processing. 
 · Embedded ARM controllers, IPMI . 
 · Middleware such as OpenDDS, OpenMPI, OpenCL, CUDA, OpenGL. 
 · Web interface development. 
 · Embedded system development and integration . 
 · Hands-on knowledge of PCI and VME busses is a plus. 
 
 
 Ability to function well as part of a multi-site, international team of developers. 
 Excellent communication skills. The role might involve some travel to the UK 
 This position may require exposure to information which is subject to (Support control regulations, i.e. the International Traffic in Arms regulations (ITAR) 
 All applicants must be US persons within the meaning of US regulations.
